alternative_source.notes: Same target/ list (16 codenames, including m51). Its m51/config.sh differs from Arnav's — see mehedi_differences below. Use only as an alternative input to the build workflow, not as the default.

bootloader.assertion: target/m51/installer/assertions.edify (Arnav seventeen) requires bootloader M515FXXS6DXE3; it has NO ro.boot.rp check. The ro.boot.rp check exists only in Mehedi's sixteen tree, where it EXEMPTS rp == "6" from the abort — it does not reject it. Corrected 2026-11-25 after the build #8 artifact check proved the built updater-script has no ro.boot.rp check.

build_notes: Full build downloads the source firmware (Galaxy S23, SM-S911B/INS), the target firmware (Galaxy M51, SM-M515F/BVO) and the extra firmware (Galaxy S21 FE, SM-G990B/EUX) via samloader in scripts/download_fw.sh — multi-GB, see .github/workflows/build.yml runner-limit notes.

Full build requires PLATFORM_KEY_PK8 and PLATFORM_KEY_PEM repository secrets (base64), decoded by the workflow into security/unica_platform.pk8 and security/unica_platform.x509.pem, exactly as upstream CI does. Dry-run mode does not need them.
Build command in the upstream tree is: source ./buildenv.sh m51 && ./scripts/build_dependencies.sh && ./scripts/download_fw.sh && ./scripts/extract_fw.sh && ./scripts/make_rom.sh --build-rom-zip

csc.note: CSC is the region/carrier code in the firmware string. A wrong CSC means the wrong stock firmware is downloaded and the build targets the wrong variant. Extra firmware CSC is EUX (SM-G990B/EUX/...).

fingerprint.note: Mehedi ships patches/sidefp/ (smali patch 0001-Hardcode-fingerprint-sensor-position-value.patch on services.jar). Arnav has no sidefp patch in its tree — verify fingerprint behaviour separately on seventeen.

firmware_files.note: The modified firmware files are not in the UN1CA repo.
firmware_files.source: target/m51/installer/customize.sh clones https://github.com/mehedihjoy0/M51-FIRMWARES at build/install time (mehedi: straight into $TMP_DIR; arnav: cached under out/cache/M51-FIRMWARES, re-cloned only if vbmeta.img is missing; arnav deletes any packaged recovery.img and patches vbmeta.img byte 123 to 0x03, AVB disabled)

kernel.note: No kernel is stored in the UN1CA repo. A build needs network access to the kernel release, or a pre-downloaded kernel zip.
kernel.source_arnav: Not read in full in this research — do not assume it matches mehedi
kernel.source_mehedi: patches/kernel/customize.sh downloads the latest m51-ksu*.zip (LostPrime kernel) from kurtnettle/android_kernel_samsung_sm7150 GitHub releases at build time, then replaces the kernel/DTB in the stock boot.img

mehedi_differences.note: Mehedi sixteen and Arnav seventeen share the same TARGET_NAME, CODENAME, ASSERT_MODEL, TARGET_FIRMWARE, EXTRA_FIRMWARES, partitions, DVFS/SSRM filenames and fingerprint sensor. Differences are SDK 31 vs 33, erofs vs unset, HDR true vs false, RIL empty vs 'onebinary embms_qc', Bluetooth A2DP sink false vs true, and ESE NXP/JCOP4.0 absent in mehedi vs present in arnav. Field order in the files differs; order does not matter, values do.

patches.note: Each patch is a module under target/m51/patches/<name>/ with module.prop + customize.sh. Arnav tweaks/ also ships patch_camera.py, patch_composer.py, patch_iccc.py, patch_keystoreutils.py, patch_libmeminfo.py. Patch lists differ between forks — do not copy one fork's list onto the other.

provenance.note: All firmware strings and partition sizes above are copied verbatim from those files. No firmware version was invented.

ril.note: Vendored in patches/ril/vendor/ in both forks. Device-specific — a71's ril/ vendors only 3 of these libraries. Do not reuse another device's RIL blobs.

soc_detail.name: Qualcomm Snapdragon 730G
soc_detail.note: No TARGET_PLATFORM line in either fork's target/m51/config.sh, and there is no platform/sm7150/ directory in any of the three repos. The sm7150 identity is carried by dvfs_policy_sm7150_xx / siop_m51_sm7150 and by the debloat.sh / sff.sh headers. Do not invent TARGET_PLATFORM="sm7150".

status.note: Read-only research. No build was run. Validate this file against the upstream target/m51/ files before building — see devices/README.md for the modify-and-fix loop.

upstream.note: Primary source for this file (see provenance). Described as UN1CA 5.x One UI 9 / 9.5 for M51.

upstream_base.notes: Base UN1CA has 15 targets and does NOT include m51. The SM7150 forks add m51.
